summary: Frontend-only testing of GymHub login page. All 8 requested features tested and passing.

ui_bugs.issue: Loading spinner/disabled state not visually captured in test (backend fails too fast to observe isPending=true). Functionally, Loader2 spinner is in JSX conditionally rendered - code is correct but hard to test without slow backend.

issues: Background image loads from Unsplash external URL - may fail in offline environments, but works fine in preview

critical_code_review_comments: AuthLayout reads theme from authStore and applies dark class via useEffect - correct pattern
PublicRoute correctly redirects authenticated users to appropriate dashboard by role
Form validation with Zod + react-hook-form works correctly (email format, required password)
Error toast shows 'Ocurrió un error inesperado' when backend is unavailable - generic but functional
React Router v6 future flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) - minor, not breaking
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page UI fully functional. Dark theme active by default. Form validation works. Root / redirects to /login. Error toast shown when backend unavailable. Mobile responsive (left panel hidden). Toggle password works. Backend Django at localhost:8000 is NOT running in this environment - all API calls fail with generic error toast.
